title: HtmlInputButton
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type button without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputButton.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet that the component destructures out of the props, so it is never spread onto the element. The markup never references it, so passing children has no effect on the rendered output, and the value is undefined when omitted.

outputs.name: HtmlInputButton
outputs.description: The native input element itself: the tag is always input, every prop other than children is spread onto it, and type is always button because it is set after the spread. No wrapper element is added, and the element body holds only whitespace, so no child content is rendered.
